title: 3-Day Yellowstone, Grand Teton and Jackson Hole Guided Tour
includes: Professional transportations(Type of vehicle used based on the number of guests attending that day)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Yellowstone National Park Access Updates The East Gate is scheduled to open on 05/02/2025. Until then, attractions such as Upper and Lower Falls, Artist Point, Hayden Canyon, Mud Volcano, Fishing Bridge, and West Thumb Geyser will be inaccessible. The South Gate is set to open on 05/10/2025, meaning West Thumb Geyser will remain inaccessible between 05/02/2025 and 05/09/2025. Thank you for your understanding during these seasonal closures.
Age and Safety: Customers under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant women may join if under 24 weeks by the trip's end.
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, sun hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, cash, and drinks for hydration.
Booking Details: Ensure all booking details (name, contact, flight info) are accurate. Errors will result in personal costs. A reachable phone number is required for safety and communication.

Pick-Up Location Policy：When booking, please select your pick-up hotel. If undecided, you may update your pick-up location later. However, you must contact us or update this information yourself at least 3 days before the tour date. Important: Failure to provide or update your pick-up location prior to the departure date may result in missing the tour. The company will not be responsible for missed tours, and any fees paid will not be refunded.

Hotel Rooms: Accommodate 2-4 guests with either two Full/Double beds or one King/Queen bed (based on availability); deposits are processed via credit card. For groups over four or separate rooms, please book separately.
Tickets and Charges: Pre-purchased tickets or city passes are not accepted. Buy through us or via the guide. Group reservations recommended.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Experience the ultimate Rocky Mountains road trip on this unforgettable 3-day adventure from Salt Lake City to Yellowstone and Grand Teton National Parks. Travel through classic Western landscapes, charming mountain towns, and some of the most geologically active terrain on Earth! Stand beneath the iconic elk antler arches in Jackson, marvel at the dramatic peaks of Grand Teton, and dive deep into Yellowstone’s world of geysers, hot springs, waterfalls, and wildlife. Witness Old Faithful erupt, gaze into the rainbow colors of Grand Prismatic Spring, and explore bubbling mud pots and steaming basins across the park. The journey wraps up with close-up wildlife encounters at Yellowstone Bear World and a peaceful stop at the Great Salt Lake. With park admissions, hotel stays, and professional transportation included, this multi-day tour blends adventure, comfort, and jaw-dropping scenery into one seamless experience.
